items: [fix] Publish refused recipes with a Verse module path. A path like `/<account>@fortnite.com/<project>/...` matches the e-mail rule of the privacy check and also names the map. `recipe-add` now stores a placeholder (`/<Account>@fortnite.com/<Project>`), and `collect_recipes.py` cleans the same path in recipes saved by an older kit, so the publish no longer stops on it. The mechanics skill says to put the project's own account and name back when a recipe is copied into a project.

[fix] publish.ps1 rebuilds the kit numbers and wiki after collecting recipes. Collecting recipes and promoting skills changes the counts, and the tests then failed with "kit stats are OUT OF DATE"; the two builds now run before the tests.
release.title: v1.121.1 — Recipes no longer block the publish
